```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{SelectionSort}{$A[1..n]$}\For{$last\gets n$ downto $2$}\State $max\gets1$\For{$i\gets2$ to $last$}\If{$A[i]&gt;A[max]$}\State $max\gets i$\EndIf\EndFor\State \Call{Swap}{$A[max],A[last]$}\EndFor\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
